Billing questions

The rest of it

Is the ₹1,999 a real price?
It is what everyone pays once the first 500 creators have subscribed. A discount from a price nobody is ever charged is a fabricated one, and we are not opening with that.
Why are 3, 6 and 9 months not cheaper per month?
They are not a discount ladder. They exist for the creator who would rather not think about it again for a while. Only the twelve month term is discounted.
Is GST included?
No. Every figure is before GST at 18%, and you get a tax invoice carrying your GSTIN if you have given us one.
How many people can use one workspace?
Up to 5. You choose what each of them sees, and no invited manager can delete anything.
Do I need a card to start?
No. The trial takes an email address and lets you create 10 deals.

Try it for 14 days first.

No card, no call, and your existing deals imported in a few minutes.
